definition: Users or units eligible for proactive guidance in the observational table.
`proactive_guidance`: whether the unit received guidance during the exposure window.
`future_engagement`: later engagement measured after the exposure and activation windows.
Average total effect of guidance versus no guidance.
Adjust for pre-treatment confounders, not post-treatment activation depth.
Credibility depends on no unmeasured confounding after observed pre-treatment covariates.
